6    local function SafeWaitForChild(parent, childName)
7        local success, result = pcall(function()
8            return parent:WaitForChild(childName)
9        end)
10        if not success or not result then
11            warn("noooooo: " .. childName)
12        end
13        return result
14    end
15
16    local function WaitChilds(path, ...)
17        local last = path
18        for _, child in {...} do
19            last = last:FindFirstChild(child) or SafeWaitForChild(last, child)
20            if not last then break end
21        end
22        return last
23    end

72    Module.FastAttack = (function()
73        if _ENV.rz_FastAttack then
74            return _ENV.rz_FastAttack
75        end
76
77        local FastAttack = {
78            Distance = 100,
79            attackMobs = true,
80            attackPlayers = true,
81            Equipped = nil
82        }
83
84        local RegisterAttack = SafeWaitForChild(Net, "RE/RegisterAttack")
85        local RegisterHit = SafeWaitForChild(Net, "RE/RegisterHit")
86
87        local function IsAlive(character)
88        return character and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and character.Humanoid.Health > 0
89        end
90
91        local function ProcessEnemies(OthersEnemies, Folder)
92            local BasePart = nil
93            for _, Enemy in Folder:GetChildren() do
94                local Head = Enemy:FindFirstChild("Head")
95                if Head and IsAlive(Enemy) and Player:DistanceFromCharacter(Head.Position) < FastAttack.Distance then
96                    if Enemy ~= Player.Character then
97                        table.insert(OthersEnemies, { Enemy, Head })
98                        BasePart = Head
99                    end
100                end
101            end
102            return BasePart
103        end
104
105        function FastAttack:Attack(BasePart, OthersEnemies)
106            if not BasePart or #OthersEnemies == 0 then return end
107            RegisterAttack:FireServer(Settings.ClickDelay or 0)
108            RegisterHit:FireServer(BasePart, OthersEnemies)
109        end
110
111        function FastAttack:AttackNearest()
112            local OthersEnemies = {}
113            local Part1 = ProcessEnemies(OthersEnemies, Enemies)
114            local Part2 = ProcessEnemies(OthersEnemies, Characters)
115            if #OthersEnemies > 0 then
116                self:Attack(Part1 or Part2, OthersEnemies)
117            else
118                task.wait(0)
119            end
120        end
121
122        function FastAttack:BladeHits()
123            local Equipped = IsAlive(Player.Character) and Player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
124            if Equipped and Equipped.ToolTip ~= "Gun" then
125                self:AttackNearest()
126            else
127                task.wait(0)
128            end
129        end
130
131        task.spawn(function()
132            while task.wait(Settings.ClickDelay) do
133                if Settings.AutoClick then
134                    FastAttack:BladeHits()
135                end
136            end
137        end)
138
139        _ENV.rz_FastAttack = FastAttack
140        return FastAttack
141    end)()
142end

1232function UpdateIslandESP() 
1233    for i,v in pairs(game:GetService("Workspace")["_WorldOrigin"].Locations:GetChildren()) do
1234        pcall(function()
1235            if IslandESP then 
1236                if v.Name ~="Sea" then
1237                    if not v:FindFirstChild('NameEsp') then
1238                        local bill = Instance.new('BillboardGui',v)

2070function Tween2(KG)
2071    local Distance = (KG.Position - game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
2072    local Speed = 350
2073    local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(Distance / Speed, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear)
2074    local tween = game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart, tweenInfo, {
2075        CFrame = KG
2076    })
2077    tween:Play()
2078    if _G.StopTween2 then
2079        tween:Cancel()
2080    end
2081    _G.Clip2 = true
2082    wait(Distance / Speed)
2083    _G.Clip2 = false
2084end

2176function AttackNoCoolDown()
2177    local character = player.Character
2178    if not character then return end
2179    local equippedWeapon = nil
2180    for _, item in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
2181        if item:IsA("Tool") then
2182            equippedWeapon = item
2183            break
2184        end
2185    end
2186    if not equippedWeapon then return end
2187    local function IsEntityAlive(entity)
2188        return entity and entity:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and entity.Humanoid.Health > 0
2189    end
2190    local function GetEnemiesInRange(range)
2191        local enemies = game:GetService("Workspace").Enemies:GetChildren()
2192        local targets = {}
2193        local playerPos = character:GetPivot().Position
2194        for _, enemy in ipairs(enemies) do
2195            local primaryPart = enemy:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
2196            if primaryPart and IsEntityAlive(enemy) and (primaryPart.Position - playerPos).Magnitude <= range then
2197                table.insert(targets, enemy)
2198            end
2199        end
2200        return targets
2201    end
2202    if equippedWeapon:FindFirstChild("LeftClickRemote") then
2203        local attackCount = 1  
2204        local enemiesInRange = GetEnemiesInRange(60)
2205        for _, enemy in ipairs(enemiesInRange) do
2206            local direction = (enemy.HumanoidRootPart.Position - character:GetPivot().Position).Unit
2207            pcall(function()
2208                equippedWeapon.LeftClickRemote:FireServer(direction, attackCount)
2209            end)
2210            attackCount = attackCount + 1
2211            if attackCount > 10000000000000 then attackCount = 1 end
2212        end
2213    else
2214        local targets = {}
2215        local enemies = game:GetService("Workspace").Enemies:GetChildren()
2216        local playerPos = character:GetPivot().Position
2217        local mainTarget = nil
2218        for _, enemy in ipairs(enemies) do
2219            if not enemy:GetAttribute("IsBoat") and IsEntityAlive(enemy) then

4021local rotationSequence = {80, -50, -80, 50} 
4022local currentStep = 1 
4023local function getPlayerBoat()
4024    for _, boat in pairs(Workspace.Boats:GetChildren()) do
4025        local seat = boat:FindFirstChild("VehicleSeat")
4026        if seat and seat.Occupant == character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
4027            return boat
4028        end
4029    end
4030    return nil
4031end
4032RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
4033    if not character or not character.PrimaryPart then return end
4034    local distance = (character.PrimaryPart.Position - npcPosition).Magnitude
4035    local distanceInMeters = math.floor(distance / 10)
4036    if distanceInMeters >= nextDistance then
4037        local boat = getPlayerBoat()
4038        if boat and boat.PrimaryPart then
4039            local angle = rotationSequence[currentStep]
4040            local newRotation = boat.PrimaryPart.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(angle), 0)
4041            boat:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(newRotation)
4042            currentStep = currentStep + 1
4043            if currentStep > #rotationSequence then
4044                currentStep = 1 
4045            end
4046            nextDistance = nextDistance + 1000
4047        end
4048    end
4049end)
4050local seatHistory, isTeleporting, notified = {}, false, false
4051local islandsToDelete = {
4052    Prehistoric = { "ShipwreckIsland", "SandIsland", "TreeIsland", "TinyIsland", "MysticIsland", "KitsuneIsland", "FrozenDimension" },
4053    Mirage = { "ShipwreckIsland", "SandIsland", "TreeIsland", "TinyIsland", "PrehistoricIsland", "KitsuneIsland", "FrozenDimension" },
4054    Frozen = { "ShipwreckIsland", "SandIsland", "TreeIsland", "TinyIsland", "MysticIsland", "KitsuneIsland", "PrehistoricIsland" }
4055}
4056local function createToggle(title, toggleKey, islands, islandName, notification)
4057    local toggle = Tabs.Sea:AddToggle(toggleKey, { Title = title, Default = false })
4058    Options[toggleKey]:SetValue(false)
4059    toggle:OnChanged(function(value) _G[toggleKey] = value end)
4060    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
4061        if not _G[toggleKey] then
4062            notified = false
4063            return
4064        end
4065        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
4066        if not humanoid then return end
4067        local function tpToMyBoat()
4068            if isTeleporting then return end
4069            isTeleporting = true
4070            for _, seat in pairs(seatHistory) do
4071                if seat and seat.Parent and seat.Name == "VehicleSeat" and not seat.Occupant then
4072                    Tween2(seat.CFrame)
4073                    break
4074                end
4075            end
4076            isTeleporting = false
4077        end
4078        local boatFound, currentBoat = false, nil
4079        for _, boat in pairs(Workspace.Boats:GetChildren()) do
4080            local seat = boat:FindFirstChild("VehicleSeat")
4081            if seat then
4082                if seat.Occupant == humanoid then
4083                    boatFound, currentBoat = true, seat
4084                    seatHistory[boat.Name] = seat
4085                elseif seat.Occupant == nil then
4086                    tpToMyBoat()
4087                end
4088            end
4089        end
4090        if not boatFound then return end
4091        currentBoat.MaxSpeed = SetSpeedBoat
4092        currentBoat.CFrame = CFrame.new(currentBoat.Position) * currentBoat.CFrame.Rotation
4093        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, "W", false, game)
4094        for _, part in pairs(Workspace.Boats:GetDescendants()) do
4095            if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CanCollide = false end
4096        end
4097        for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
4098            if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CanCollide = false end
4099        end
4100        for _, island in ipairs(islands) do
4101            local toDelete = Workspace.Map:FindFirstChild(island)
4102            if toDelete and toDelete:IsA("Model") then
4103                toDelete:Destroy()
4104            end
4105        end
4106        local targetIsland = Workspace.Map:FindFirstChild(islandName)
4107        if targetIsland then
4108            VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, "W", false, game)
4109            _G[toggleKey] = false
4110            if not notified then
4111                Fluent:Notify({
4112                    Title = "Ten Hub",
4113                    Content = notification,
4114                    Duration = 10
4115                })
4116                notified = true
4117            end
4118        end
4119    end)
4120end

6500local Time = Tabs.Status:AddParagraph({
6501    Title="Time",
6502    Content=""
6503})
6504local function UpdateLocalTime()
6505    local date = os.date("*t")
6506    local hour = date.hour % 24
6507    local ampm = hour<12 and "AM" or "PM"
6508    local formattedTime = string.format("%02i:%02i:%02i %s", ((hour-1) % 12)+1, date.min, date.sec, ampm)
6509    local formattedDate = string.format("%02d/%02d/%04d", date.day, date.month, date.year)
6510    local LocalizationService = game:GetService("LocalizationService")
6511    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
6512    local player = Players.LocalPlayer
6513    local name = player.Name
6514    local regionCode = "Unknown"
6515    local success, code=pcall(function()
6516        return LocalizationService:GetCountryRegionForPlayerAsync(player)
6517    end)
6518    if success then
6519        regionCode=code
6520    end
6521    Time:SetDesc(formattedDate .. "-" .. formattedTime .. " [ " .. regionCode .. " ]")
6522end
6523spawn(function()
6524    while true do
6525        UpdateLocalTime()
6526        game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Wait()
6527    end
6528end)

6537    local Second = GameTime % 60
6538    ServerTime:SetDesc(string.format("%02d Hour-%02d Minute-%02d Second", Hour, Minute, Second))

7145Tabs.Visual:AddButton({
7146    Title="Visual",
7147    Description="",
7148    Callback=function()
7149        local plr = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
7150        local Notification = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Notification)
7151        local Data = plr:WaitForChild("Data")
7152        local EXPFunction = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("EXPFunction"))
7153        local LevelUp = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Effect.Container.LevelUp)
7154        local Sound = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Util.Sound)
7155        local LevelUpSound = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Util.Sound.Storage.Other:FindFirstChild("LevelUp_Proxy") or game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Util.Sound.Storage.Other:FindFirstChild("LevelUp")
7156        function v129(p15)
7157            local v130 = p15;
7158            while true do
7159                local v131, v132=string.gsub(v130, "^(-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2");
7160                v130=v131;
7161                if v132==0 then
7162                    break;
7163                end;    
7164            end;
7165            return v130;
7166        end;
7167        Notification.new("<Color=Yellow>QUEST COMPLETED!<Color=/>"):Display()
7168        Notification.new("Earned<Color=Yellow>9,999,999,999,999 Exp.<Color=/>(+None)"):Display()
7169        Notification.new("Earned<Color=Green>$9,999,999,999,999<Color=/>"):Display()
7170        plr.Data.Exp.Value=999999999999
7171        plr.Data.Beli.Value=plr.Data.Beli.Value+999999999999
7172        delay=0
7173        count=0
7174        while plr.Data.Exp.Value-EXPFunction(Data.Level.Value)>0 do
7175            plr.Data.Exp.Value=plr.Data.Exp.Value-EXPFunction(Data.Level.Value)
7176            plr.Data.Level.Value=plr.Data.Level.Value+1
7177            plr.Data.Points.Value=plr.Data.Points.Value+3
7178            LevelUp({ plr })
7179            Sound.Play(Sound, LevelUpSound.Value)
7180            Notification.new("<Color=Green>LEVEL UP!<Color=/>(" .. plr.Data.Level.Value .. ")"):Display()
7181            count=count+1
7182            if count>=5 then
7183                delay=tick()
7184                count=0
7185                wait()
7186            end
7187        end
7188    end
7189})

7521function UpdateRealFruitEsp() 
7522    for _, v in pairs(game.Workspace.AppleSpawner:GetChildren()) do
7523        if v:IsA("Tool") then
7524            if RealFruitEsp then 
7525                if not v.Handle:FindFirstChild('NameEsp'..Number) then
7526                    local bill = Instance.new('BillboardGui', v.Handle)
7527                    bill.Name='NameEsp'..Number
7528                    bill.ExtentsOffset=Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
7529                    bill.Size=UDim2.new(1, 200, 1, 30)
7530                    bill.Adornee=v.Handle
7531                    bill.AlwaysOnTop=true
7532                    local name = Instance.new('TextLabel', bill)
7533                    name.Font=Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
7534                    name.FontSize="Size14"
7535                    name.TextWrapped=true
7536                    name.Size=UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
7537                    name.TextYAlignment='Top'
7538                    name.BackgroundTransparency=1
7539                    name.TextStrokeTransparency=0.5
7540                    name.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
7541                    name.Text=(v.Name .. ' \n' .. round((game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer.Character.Head.Position-v.Handle.Position).Magnitude/3) .. ' Distance')
7542                else
7543                    v.Handle['NameEsp'..Number].TextLabel.Text=(v.Name .. ' ' .. round((game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer.Character.Head.Position-v.Handle.Position).Magnitude/3) .. ' Distance')
7544                end
7545            else
7546                if v.Handle:FindFirstChild('NameEsp'..Number) then
7547                    v.Handle:FindFirstChild('NameEsp'..Number):Destroy()
7548                end
7549            end 
7550        end
7551    end
7552    for _, v in pairs(game.Workspace.PineappleSpawner:GetChildren()) do

8527function Hop()
8528    local PlaceID = game.PlaceId
8529    local AllIDs = {}
8530    local foundAnything = ""
8531    local actualHour = os.date("!*t").hour
8532    local Deleted = false
8533    function TPReturner()
8534        local Site;
8535        if foundAnything=="" then
8536            Site=game.HttpService:JSONDecode(game:HttpGet('https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/' .. PlaceID .. '/servers/Public?sortOrder=Asc&limit=100'))
8537        else
8538            Site=game.HttpService:JSONDecode(game:HttpGet('https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/' .. PlaceID .. '/servers/Public?sortOrder=Asc&limit=100&cursor=' .. foundAnything))
8539        end
8540        local ID = ""
8541        if Site.nextPageCursor and Site.nextPageCursor ~="null" and Site.nextPageCursor ~=nil then
8542            foundAnything=Site.nextPageCursor
8543        end
8544        local num = 0;
8545        for i,v in pairs(Site.data) do
8546            local Possible = true
8547            ID=tostring(v.id)
8548            if tonumber(v.maxPlayers)>tonumber(v.playing) then
8549                for _,Existing in pairs(AllIDs) do
8550                    if num ~=0 then
8551                        if ID==tostring(Existing) then
8552                            Possible=false
8553                        end
8554                    else
8555                        if tonumber(actualHour) ~=tonumber(Existing) then
8556                            local delFile = pcall(function()
8557                                AllIDs={}
8558                                table.insert(AllIDs, actualHour)
8559                            end)
8560                        end
8561                    end
8562                    num=num+1
8563                end
8564                if Possible==true then
8565                    table.insert(AllIDs, ID)
8566                    wait()
8567                    pcall(function()
8568                        wait()
8569                        game:GetService("TeleportService"):TeleportToPlaceInstance(PlaceID, ID, game.Players.LocalPlayer)
8570                    end)
8571                    wait()
8572                end
8573            end
8574        end
8575    end
8576    function Teleport() 
8577        while wait() do
8578            pcall(function()
8579                TPReturner()
8580                if foundAnything ~="" then
8581                    TPReturner()
8582                end
8583            end)
8584        end
8585    end
8586    Teleport()
8587end

8882local function equipAndUseSkill(toolType)
8883    local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
8884    local backpack = player.Backpack
8885    for _, item in pairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
8886        if item:IsA("Tool") and item.ToolTip == toolType then
8887            item.Parent = player.Character  
8888            for _, skill in ipairs({"Z", "X", "C", "V", "F"}) do
8889                wait() 
8890                pcall(function() sendSkillKey(skill) end) 
8891            end
8892            item.Parent = backpack
8893            break
8894        end
8895    end
8896end

9136local function removeLava()
9137    local interiorLavaModel = game.Workspace.Map.PrehistoricIsland.Core:FindFirstChild("InteriorLava")
9138    if interiorLavaModel and interiorLavaModel:IsA("Model") then
9139        interiorLavaModel:Destroy()
9140    end
9141    local prehistoricIsland1 = game.Workspace.Map:FindFirstChild("PrehistoricIsland")
9142    if prehistoricIsland1 then
9143        for _, descendant in pairs(prehistoricIsland1:GetDescendants()) do
9144            if descendant:IsA("Part") and descendant.Name:lower():find("lava") then
9145                descendant:Destroy()
9146            end
9147        end
9148    end
9149    local prehistoricIsland2 = game.Workspace.Map:FindFirstChild("PrehistoricIsland")
9150    if prehistoricIsland2 then
9151        for _, model in pairs(prehistoricIsland2:GetDescendants()) do
9152            if model:IsA("Model") then
9153                for _, child in pairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
9154                    if child:IsA("MeshPart") and child.Name:lower():find("lava") then
9155                        child:Destroy()
9156                    end
9157                end
9158            end
9159        end
9160    end
9161end
9162local function findValidRock()
9163    local volcanoRocksFolder = game.Workspace.Map.PrehistoricIsland.Core.VolcanoRocks
9164    for _, Rock in pairs(volcanoRocksFolder:GetChildren()) do
9165        if Rock:IsA("Model") then
9166            local volcanorock = Rock:FindFirstChild("volcanorock")
9167            if volcanorock and volcanorock:IsA("MeshPart") then
9168                local color = volcanorock.Color
9169                if color == Color3.fromRGB(185, 53, 56) or color == Color3.fromRGB(185, 53, 57) then
9170                    return volcanorock
9171                end
9172            end
9173        end
9174    end
9175    return nil 
9176end
9177local function equipAndUseSkill(toolType)
9178    local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
9179    local backpack = player.Backpack
9180    for _, item in pairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
9181        if item:IsA("Tool") and item.ToolTip == toolType then
9182            item.Parent = player.Character 
9183            for _, skill in ipairs({"Z", "X", "C", "V", "F"}) do
9184                wait() 
9185                pcall(function() useSkill(skill) end) 
9186            end
9187            item.Parent = backpack
9188            break
9189        end
9190    end
9191end
